notes.title: Quality-of-Life Update: Focus-based Mute & Auto-Resize Window
notes.notes:
This update adds two useful features to improve your playing experience:


- Focus-based mute
The game will now automatically mute all audio when you alt-tab or the window loses focus.  

When you return to the game, the sound will come back on its own.


- Maximized window at launch
The game will now start in a maximized window by default, making it easier to jump right into gameplay.



Thank you for playing CountUp!
